I have the complete trace. The exploration agent is still running in the background, but I've independently verified the full chain, so I'll answer now.

h07.

A browser fetches another user's avatar at `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar`. The "stored data" is not a blob/file on disk — the avatar is a base64 `data:` URI held inline in the `avatar_url` column of the `user` table, so the path bottoms out at a SQL `SELECT` of that column.

Hops from serving handler to data layer:

```
GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar (route) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124
serveUserAvatar — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168
getUserByUsername — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715
Store.GetUser — store/user.go:148
Store.ListUsers — store/user.go:136
(*DB).ListUsers (driver) — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88
SELECT ... avatar_url FROM user (QueryContext + rows.Scan → user.AvatarURL) — store/db/sqlite/user.go:173
```

Notes:
